integrity.finite_check: VERIFY.py enumerates 772452 set partitions in 37 instances; plateau identity checked for a from 4 to 100.
integrity.proof_basis: Independent-set reduction plus convex size-vector majorization, constructive attainment, and exact combinatorial counting.
integrity.result_scope: Exact Nash product, unique optimizer size shape, multiplicity, first-two-edge plateau, and fixed-matching-size asymptotic product ratios.

scientific_limitations: The theorem assumes symmetric aversion-to-enemies valuations and disjoint additional enemy edges confined to one part of a complete bipartite enemy graph.
The exact formulas concern positive-Nash-product coalition structures for \(a\ge4\), \(b\ge2\), and \(1\le t\le\lfloor a/2\rfloor\).
The public abstract of the central source was inspected, but its full primary text was inaccessible; unindexed equivalent prior results remain possible.
Finite exhaustive checks do not establish the unbounded theorem.
title: A matching-edge plateau for Nash products on nearly bipartite enemy graphs
